x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
ratio = x / y
result_num, result_denom = 0, 1
min_difference = float('inf')

for denom in range(1, n + 1):
    val = ratio * denom
    num_floor = int(val)
    num_ceil = num_floor + 1

    diff_floor = abs(ratio - num_floor / denom)
    diff_ceil = abs(num_ceil / denom - ratio)

    if diff_floor < min_difference:
        min_difference = diff_floor
        result_num, result_denom = num_floor, denom
    if diff_ceil < min_difference:
        min_difference = diff_ceil
        result_num, result_denom = num_ceil, denom

print(f"{result_num}/{result_denom}")
